gradients.name: silver-metal
gradients.purpose: Logo mark tile (also the host avatar) and send button only.

label.purpose: Tabs, rows, steps, chips, key-values, timeline, buttons (500).

meta.purpose: Session meta, model selector, lock heading (600).

caption.purpose: Section labels, status bar, fine print, queued header.

mono-title-id.purpose: Run id leading the detail title.

shadows.name: edge-control
shadows.purpose: Solid buttons, pills, composer, host question.

shadows.name: edge-selected
shadows.purpose: Selected session, avatars, selected phone tab, hovered pill, focused composer.

shadows.name: edge-lock
shadows.purpose: Lock card and unlock note; #e8772e on focus.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Every non-linear motion: ping, draw, rise, settle, chevron.

motion.name: spin-running
motion.value: spin 1s linear infinite; rotate 0 to 360deg about (7,7)

motion.name: ping
motion.value: 1.9s ease-standard infinite; 0% scale(.55) opacity .9; 80%,100% scale(1.7) opacity 0
motion.purpose: Needs-you ring around a filled neon-orange core.

motion.name: draw
motion.value: 0.5s ease-standard 0.1s delay forwards; stroke-dasharray 12, dashoffset 12 to 0
motion.purpose: Check on newly finished items only.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: 0.45s ease-standard; from opacity 0 translateY(6px) to rest
motion.purpose: New stream items and steps entering.

motion.name: rise-unlock
motion.purpose: Unlock form opening in place inside the lock card.

motion.name: settle
motion.value: 0.7s ease-standard; 0% opacity 0 translateY(-8px) rotate(-1.2deg); 60% opacity 1 translateY(1px) rotate(.3deg); 100% none
motion.purpose: Lock card arriving, like a tag hung on a hook.

motion.name: composer-focus
motion.purpose: Composer edge to silver on focus-within.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce): animation none, transition none, fresh check dashoffset 0
motion.purpose: All motion off; every element already visible in its final state.

narrative.overview:
A pure black room where everything at rest is grey and silver, and the only light comes from work that is happening right now. Agents spin, wait and call for the user in fluorescent green, yellow and orange; the moment something stops moving it drops to an ordinary green, yellow or orange. The page reads calm at a glance and tells the user, by where the light is, what is alive and what is waiting on them.

The material is soft rather than industrial-hard: generous radii on every row, card and field (10 to 18px), pill-shaped answers, sentence-case system type at a 14.5px base, edges drawn as hairline inset strokes instead of shadows. Silver is the only "metal": bright silver marks names, titles and selection, and a brushed-silver gradient appears on exactly two objects, the logo mark and the send button.

The signature is the motion grammar of the status glyphs. A spinning arc, a slow dashed ring, a pinging dot, a check that draws itself only when a step has just finished, a pause ring and a lock. New items rise into the stream, a lock card settles into place like a tag hung on a hook. Every element is visible without animation, and reduced motion switches all of it off.
keyCharacteristics: Pure black ground, near-black rails, three soft grey raise steps; no drop shadows anywhere.
Silver for names, titles and selection; brushed-silver gradient only on the logo mark and send button.
Fluorescent colour only on glyphs of work in motion; normal green, yellow and orange for finished and static states.
Soft radii: 10px rows, 12px session cards, 16px cards, 18px composer, pill answers.
Sentence-case system UI type; monospace only for shas, ids, paths and times.
An animated 14px status-glyph set and a short motion grammar (rise, settle, draw) as the signature.

rules.name: The Motion-Only Neon Rule
rules.body: Fluorescent colour lives only on a glyph whose state is in progress (running, waiting, needs you). When the state ends, the glyph is replaced by its normal-colour counterpart. No text, fill, border or button is ever neon.

rules.name: The Two Metal Objects Rule
rules.body: The brushed-silver gradient appears on the logo mark (including where it stands for the host) and the send button. Nothing else is metal.

rules.name: The Orange Means Locked Rule
rules.body: Static orange belongs to locks and to the counts of things that need the user. It is never decoration, and warn buttons are the only filled orange controls.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: Monospace is used for shas, ids, paths, commands and times, and for nothing a person would read as words.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Every label, tab, button and heading is sentence case. No uppercase labels, no tracking-out, no small caps.

rules.name: The Inset Edge Rule
rules.body: Edges are inset 1px strokes or tonal steps. If something looks like it needs a shadow, give it the next raise step instead.

rules.name: The Draw Once Rule
rules.body: The check draws only for an item that finished while the user was watching. Nothing replays on load or on scroll.

rules.name: The Exact Sha Rule
rules.body: Any control that accepts a result names the sha in its own label, and the text beside it says the decision applies to that sha only.

rules.name: The Still Page Rule
rules.body: Remove all motion and the page must say exactly the same thing.

dos: Do keep the page on Ground (#000000) with Rail Black panels and the three raise steps; give contained or selected things the next raise step up.
Do swap a neon glyph for its normal-colour counterpart the instant its state stops: running arc to verified check, waiting ring to pause ring or nothing, needs-you ping to lock or resolved.
Do draw edges as 1px inset box-shadows (Line High for controls, Silver Edge for selection, Lock Edge for locks).
Do use the radius ladder: 10px rows, 12px session cards, 16px cards, 18px composer, full pills for answers.
Do put the exact sha in the Accept pill's label and repeat it in the fine print.
Do open the unlock note in place inside the lock card, with "Keep locked" beside "Sign & remove lock".
Do render every element in its final state first and treat rise, settle and draw as entrances only; honour `prefers-reduced-motion` by turning all of them off.
Do use monospace with tabular numerals for shas, ids, paths, commands and times.
donts: Don't use fluorescent green, yellow or orange on text, fills, borders, buttons or anything at rest.
Don't put the brushed-silver gradient on anything except the logo mark and the send button.
Don't add drop shadows, glows or blur; depth is tonal.
Don't use uppercase labels, letter-spaced eyebrows or small caps; everything is sentence case.
Don't set names, labels or sentences in monospace.
Don't use circular avatars; avatars are rounded squares with a status dot at the corner.
Don't replay the check draw on load; only newly finished items animate.
Don't fill a button orange unless it removes a lock.
